about: Ionen: Vanadium und seine Oxidationsstufen, Nickel; der Trennungsgang folgt

VO2+(aq).src: no enthalpy of formation entered; absorption band estimated from the usual colour of an acidic vanadate solution (pale yellow)

VO^2+(aq).src: no enthalpy of formation entered; absorption bands estimated from the usual colour of vanadyl sulfate solution (blue)

V^3+(aq).src: no enthalpy of formation entered; absorption bands estimated from the usual colour of vanadium(III) solution (green)

V^2+(aq).src: no enthalpy of formation entered; absorption bands estimated from the usual colour of vanadium(II) solution (violet)

Ni(s).src: element: enthalpy of formation zero by definition; S: NBS Tables of Chemical Thermodynamic Properties (Wagman et al. 1982); colour of the metal

Ni^2+(aq).src: no enthalpy of formation entered; diffusion coefficient: phreeqc.dat (USGS), -dw; absorption bands: usual table values for the hexaaqua ion (395, 655 and 720 nm)

Ni(NH3)6^2+(aq).src: no enthalpy of formation entered; absorption bands estimated from usual table values (around 360 and 580 nm, blue-violet)

Ni(OH)2(s).src: colour of the solid from its usual appearance (pale green)

C4H8N2O2(aq).src: no enthalpy of formation entered; colourless

Ni(C4H7N2O2)2(s).src: colour of the solid from its usual appearance (strawberry red)

couples.src: minteq.v4.dat (USGS): VO2+ + e- + 2 H+ = VO+2 + H2O, log_k 16.903
minteq.v4.dat (USGS): VO+2 + e- + 2 H+ = V+3 + H2O, log_k 5.696
llnl.dat (USGS): Ni + 2 H+ + 0.5 O2 = H2O + Ni+2, log_k 50.9914; referred to the hydrogen electrode with H2(g) + 0.5 O2 = H2O, log_k 43.0016. Overpotential estimated

ghs.src: mixture rules by hand: sulfuric acid 1 mol/L (about 9 %) is Skin Irrit. 2 and Eye Irrit. 2 (CLP Annex VI 016-020-00-8, SCL); ammonium metavanadate 0.6 % stays below the limits of its Acute Tox. 3 and Muta. 2 (supplier SDS)

name.en: ammonium vanadate in sulfuric acid (0.05 mol/L)

NH4VO3 acidic.src: 5.85 g ammonium metavanadate per litre of sulfuric acid 1 mol/L; the vanadate takes up two H+ per vanadium and is VO2+

ghs.src: nickel sulfate, CLP Annex VI 028-009-00-5 (Carc. 1A, Muta. 2, Repr. 1B, STOT RE 1, Resp. and Skin Sens. 1, Aquatic Chronic 1); 1.5 % lies above the limits of these classes
1 % in ethanol: the ethanol makes it Flam. Liq. 2 (CLP Annex VI 603-002-00-5); dimethylglyoxime itself is not classified at this content

dimethylglyoxime.src: 1 g per 100 mL; the ethanol is not modelled

ghs.src: nickel metal, CLP Annex VI 028-002-00-7 (Carc. 2, STOT RE 1, Skin Sens. 1)

reactions.src: textbook: neighbouring oxidation states of vanadium comproportionate quickly; so each colour shows on its own while zinc reduces step by step
textbook: comproportionation of vanadium(IV) and vanadium(II)
textbook: comproportionation of vanadium(V) and vanadium(II)

equilibria.src: minteq.v4.dat (USGS): Ni(OH)2 + 2 H+ = Ni+2 + 2 H2O, log_k 12.794; converted with the ion product of water
estimated from textbook values (stability of the bis complex and acidity of dimethylglyoxime): the red precipitate forms in ammoniacal or acetate-buffered solution, not in strong acid
